question: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are seated around a round table facing the center. C sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between C and G, when counted from the left of C. Only three people sit between D and B. A sits immediate right of F. How many people sit between C and A when counted from the right of C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are seated around a round table facing the center. 

1) C sits to the immediate right of D.

2) Only three people sit between C and G, when counted from the left of C.

3) Only three people sit between D and B.

4) A sits immediate right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f252ff7083471d206efdfb87324432a77e8e13d60042ae4f587e77ac17e9178.png] 

Here, Four people sit between C and A when counted from the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
